blinkit_blr.goal: Audit quick-commerce checkout pricing. Do NOT log in, do NOT pay, do NOT enter personal details. Set location to Koramangala, Bengaluru. Use the search box to search exactly 'Bingo Tedhe Medhe'. Pick a Bingo Tedhe Medhe chips pack (if unavailable, pick any chips or biscuit pack under Rs 30; never medicines or health products). Note its listed price, add ONE to the cart, open the cart and read the bill details section. Record each bill line separately: item total, delivery charge, handling charge, small cart fee, any other fee, and the grand total. Check that the lines add up to the grand total.

booking_blr.goal: You are auditing price transparency. Do NOT enter personal details and do NOT pay. 1) On the results page, pick the first hotel and note the price on its card and any '+ taxes and charges' text. 2) Open it, select the cheapest room and click Reserve. 3) Continue to the page that shows the full price breakdown including taxes (still before entering any details) and record every line and the final total. Return JSON: hotel_name, steps [{step, page, price_shown_inr, note}], fees [{label, amount_inr}], final_total_inr, urgency [string], preticked [string].

food_order.goal: Audit checkout pricing without paying or entering personal data. Set location to Koramangala, Bengaluru. Open the first restaurant, add its cheapest item to cart, open the cart. Record the item price, every fee line (platform, packaging, delivery, small cart, GST) and the final total. Note any pre-selected tip, donation or add-on. Return JSON: steps [{step, page, price_shown_inr, note}], fees [{label, amount_inr}], final_total_inr, urgency [string], preticked [string].

streaming_cancel.goal: Using the logged-in test profile, count the clicks needed to start a subscription and the clicks needed to fully cancel it, without confirming any payment. Record each screen on the cancel path and any guilt-trip or retention wording. Return JSON: join_clicks, cancel_clicks, cancel_screens [string], urgency [string].
